incidents.name: Generic ERC-4626 inflation
incidents.note: Common pattern in vault deployments without virtual shares

steps.description: Attacker is the FIRST depositor — deposits 1 wei of the asset token
Attacker directly transfers tokens to the vault (NOT via deposit!) — inflates totalAssets without minting shares
Victim deposits 19,999 tokens — but share calculation rounds DOWN to 0!
Attacker redeems their 1 share — gets HALF of all vault assets!
Victim redeems — gets back ~15,000 instead of their 19,999 deposit
